name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches 'Do not take the box from the other room'; the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'at any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards' (door_open at that step or later); the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', since key_lost is defined as a drop while the door is not open. Preference cues make the latter two soft, and the rule-only warning is valid because the task contains no unconditional hard goal.

texts: The agent never picks up or carries the target box.
Whenever the agent holds the door key, it should try to have the door open at that moment or later.
The agent should try not to lose the key while the door is closed.
